name: TSLA Gap Protection
description: Weekend gap protection for tokenized Tesla, from GapGuard. Holders are paid back if Tesla's price at Monday's open differs from Friday's close by more than 3%, measured with Pyth's real stock price feed and recorded on-chain. Window: Friday Sep 25 4:00pm ET to Monday Sep 28 9:30am ET. A hackathon project on Solana, not audited financial infrastructure.

attributes.value: 3% move, Friday close to Monday open
